thread:
Mira: Nightly eval failure: grove-7b-q8 on 'commonsense' prompt set jumped to ~8% fail (was ~0.9%). Attaching summaries and a couple of bad generations.
jon: Yikes, saw the alert. Any runtime changes last night?
priya: Eng-runtime rolled prefetch reorder + rng-seq-fix at 02:10 UTC (PR #4251).
alex: We also changed fused_sampler seed init to happen per-microbatch rather than global in rfd3c. Commit: rfd3c9a.
claire: I ran a local regen with the nightly bundle + prefetch=true and got the same spike.
claire: Repro command:```python eval.py --model grove-7b-q8 --promptset commonsense --seed 42 --prefetch true --batch-size 1```
jon: If I force --prefetch false the failures drop back to baseline. So prefetch looks implicated.
devbot: deploy-bot: Deployed eng-runtime@rfd3c to canary cluster (02:12 UTC) - change: prefetch reorder
priya: Hypothesis: prefetch reorders KV writes/reads so RNG state (thread_local) used by fused_sampler gets reused across requests. Interaction with per-microbatch seeding could cause correlated low-entropy draws. :thinking_face:
Mira: Also note we recently merged a tiny quant tweak in q8fc softmax scaling which changes tail probabilities slightly. Could amplify sampling sensitivity.
alex: Quick experiment patch: initialize seed per-request before any prefetch, e.g.:
```c++
// before prefetch
uint64_t seed = global_seed + request_id;
set_rng_seed(seed);
// then prefetch KV
```
I'll try that locally.
claire: I captured token diffs: divergence consistently shows up at token 6-9. Sample bad output (expected vs got) attached.
jon: Plan: (1) reproduce minimal, (2) bisect between prefetch reorder and rng-init change, (3) try alex's per-request seed patch. I'll start with disabling prefetch in canary to see impact.
priya: If disabling prefetch fixes it, we'll rollback the prefetch reorder in canary and cut a hotfix. Also open an issue to enforce RNG init ordering in runtime lifecycle.
Mira: Assignments: jon -> reproduce + bisect, alex -> try seed-before-prefetch patch, priya -> prepare rollback PR and incident note, claire -> run the full commonsense promptset with three seeds (42,123,999) across q8 and q4. Check for amplification.
jon: Updating channel in 2h with results. :eyes:
Mira: Thanks team. Keep logs zipped and attach sample diffs to the ticket.
notes: thread discusses regression from nightly evals after runtime kernel/ordering changes; contains commands, small code snippets, deploy bot message, and assignment of follow-ups.
